nodes.rationale: Both pipelines share partitions; preprocessing is fit only within the current training fold; outer scores cannot select inner-HPO winners.

nodes.label: Dataset-Level MLP Minus GBDT Gap
nodes.description: One row per canonical dataset; target mean BA(MLP)-mean BA(GBDT), averaged over outer splits; predicted gap >0.01 selects MLP, else GBDT.

nodes.label: Matching Development Descriptor Sampling
nodes.rationale: Inference descriptors must match outer-training descriptors; three 75% stratified development subsets are proposed; labels are required for target-distribution descriptors.

nodes.label: Compact Meta-Feature Schema v2
nodes.rationale: Small dataset-level sample size makes many correlated predictors risky; preserve v1, evaluate compact v2 and register full-v2 ablations before outcomes.

nodes.label: Clinical Zero-Shot Protocol
nodes.description: Freeze general model/schema/margin/fallback; source-specific patient/time splits; save predictions before independent benchmark labels; no clinical refit/recalibration.

nodes.label: Family-Cluster Paired Regret Bootstrap
nodes.description: B=2000, seed42, whole-family blocks from fixed OOF losses; conditional uncertainty, not independent outer-split observations or a prediction interval.

nodes.label: Full Protocol: 366 Fits per Dataset
nodes.description: 360 inner estimator fits +6 refits; smoke has 10 fits. Host cost must be measured before expanded scheduling; never silently reduce trials.

nodes.label: Fixed Ridge and Family LOGO
nodes.source_location: §3 Предлагаемые решения, которые нужно freeze; §7 Recommender design и оценивание
nodes.rationale: Fixed scaled Ridge alpha1 regularizes small meta samples; family LOGO and equal-dataset paired regret vs meta-train-selected best fixed are primary; prospective manifest remains outstanding.

nodes.label: Tier B Working Scope
nodes.description: 20-30 general datasets and 3-5 clinical cohorts, subject to source/resource admission; 160-260 active hours are planning assumptions, not university mandates.

nodes.label: Existing Engineering Foundation

nodes.label: Research Outputs Still Missing
nodes.description: No real full benchmark corpus, trained/exported recommender, clinical transfer metrics, uncertainty/ablation outputs or final report/slides; live OpenML and upstream reproduction unverified.

nodes.label: FR-003: Source and License Evidence
nodes.rationale: Literal Public catalog labels do not establish reviewed permissions; every admitted dataset needs dated source/access/license/citation evidence.

nodes.label: FR-018: Explicit Full-Result Admission
nodes.description: Admit only canonical completed full artifacts with identity/provenance; report all smoke, malformed and excluded rejects.

nodes.label: FR-032: General and Clinical Fence
nodes.description: Clinical rows must never enter general training, preprocessing selection, feature selection or hyperparameter decisions.

nodes.label: FR-030: Labelled Unseen Inference
nodes.description: New labelled development CSV to gap/recommendation using compatible descriptors and saved model, without reading benchmark outcomes or fitting base estimators.

nodes.label: NFR-007: Fresh Locked OS Compatibility
nodes.description: Fresh locked install and offline suite on Windows and Ubuntu using Python3.14.7; upstream remains separate Linux/Python3.11.7.

nodes.label: NFR-018: Offline Default Test Suite
nodes.description: Fast socket-disabled default tests; network/expensive scenarios explicit opt-in; this is not full future integration coverage.

nodes.label: SR-006: Negative Findings Are Valid
nodes.rationale: A correctly evaluated negative/inconclusive outcome completes the research; recommender superiority is not a pass criterion.

nodes.label: R01: Too Few Independent Families
nodes.rationale: Related source versions cannot inflate effective sample size; smaller admitted corpora imply exploratory claims and wider uncertainty.

nodes.label: R06: Small-n Meta-Model Overfitting
nodes.description: Fixed regularized Ridge, compact features and grouped CV mitigate unstable OOF predictions; do not use huge post-hoc selection.

nodes.label: R07/R08: Split and Cohort Leakage
nodes.description: Fold-local spy tests plus source prediction-time/family review; invalidate affected run lineage rather than reusing corrupted scores.

nodes.label: R11: Excessive HPO Cost
nodes.description: Measure representative full costs and schedule bounded batches; reduce predeclared corpus scope rather than frozen trial counts.

nodes.label: Q01: University Rubric Unknown
nodes.description: No independent institutional rubric/deadline/format; research package can progress, but unspecified university compliance cannot be certified.

nodes.rationale: Mixed smoke/full folders and a spoofable research_valid/full-name flag do not prove canonical completed protocol.

nodes.label: A02/A06: clinical and predictor leakage risk
nodes.rationale: Clinical rows are not hard-fenced and numeric blocklists can admit outcome/provenance predictors.

nodes.label: A03: split strategy ignored
nodes.rationale: Runner always uses stratified splits even when source grouping or temporal structure is requested.

nodes.label: A07: provenance and recovery missing

nodes.rationale: Pinned example has direct_submit=true and CUDA; reproduction helper launches it without a no-submit gate.

nodes.label: Legal use and patient leakage review
nodes.rationale: Review lawful public use, license, patient grouping/time, target meaning and missingness before use.

nodes.label: Pinned source, family and clinical roles
nodes.rationale: Registry pins OpenML id/version, groups related datasets by family, marks clinical holdouts, partitions feature roles and maps positive class to one.

nodes.label: Run-log and meta schemas provisional
nodes.rationale: String dataset_id denotes registry name rather than replacing the OpenML source ID; future-runner wording predates existing runner.

nodes.label: D001: two concrete pipelines
nodes.rationale: Claims concern HistGradientBoosting and MLP pipelines, not whole model families.

nodes.label: D002/D003: continuous gap and 0.01 margin
nodes.rationale: Predict mean BA(MLP)-BA(GBDT); choose DNN only above 0.01. The margin is operational, not statistical equivalence.

nodes.label: D011: strict admission and identity
nodes.rationale: Require actual complete canonical runs, finite arithmetic and source/protocol/config/code/environment identity; flag alone is insufficient.

nodes.label: D012: general-only fence and allowlist
nodes.rationale: Clinical data cannot select general features/models/thresholds; outcomes and provenance are metadata, not predictors.

nodes.label: D013: prespecified scaled Ridge alpha 1
nodes.rationale: Fixed primary limits small-n winner-selection bias; other recommenders remain secondary and cannot replace it after final scores.

nodes.label: D014: family LOGO and paired regret
nodes.rationale: Equal-dataset regret difference compares Ridge with best fixed chosen only on meta-train; complete families remain together.

nodes.label: D015: matching inference descriptor sampler
nodes.rationale: Three stratified 75% subsets with seeds 42/137/2026 would align inference descriptors with outer-training meta rows; feasibility is unverified.

nodes.label: D016: feature schema and missingness handling
nodes.rationale: Compact v2, exact features/caps and fold-local imputation/scaling require prospective tests and freeze; v1 remains reference.

nodes.label: D017: source-specific clinical split
nodes.rationale: Patient/time protections are mandatory, while endpoints, keys, cohorts and folds require source confirmation and separate protocol identity.

nodes.label: D018: family bootstrap uncertainty
nodes.rationale: Candidate B=2000 seed42 percentile CI is conditional on fixed OOF predictions; few-family stability and secondary policy remain unfrozen.

nodes.label: D019: cohort grouping without silent dedup
nodes.rationale: Versions/shared cohorts form one family; duplicates do not create independent rows; corrections require prospective review.

nodes.label: D020: bounded no-submit upstream attempt
nodes.rationale: Audit source/environment first, then at most one permitted dataset and one minimal model when feasible, separately from P033 labels.

nodes.label: Full versus development smoke eligibility
nodes.rationale: Full uses 3 outer splits, 20 candidates/model and 3 inner folds; reduced smoke is engineering-only and not research evidence.

nodes.label: Paired stratified outer and inner partitions
nodes.rationale: Three 75/25 outer splits use seeds42/137/2026 and shuffled three-fold inner CV; both pipelines share partitions and each partition needs both classes.

nodes.label: Fold-local dense preprocessing and 512 MiB guard
nodes.rationale: Imputation/OHE/scaling fit only training folds; raw outer-training meta-features; per-matrix float64 limit is not total-memory guarantee.

nodes.label: Complete paired trials before primary admission
nodes.rationale: 360 inner fits plus six refits; retain failures, do not replace failed trials; warnings alone do not invalidate finite results.

nodes.label: Held-out family evaluation and raw regret
nodes.rationale: Clinical data are final transfer holdout; compare fixed baselines and oracle with equal dataset weights, never round near-tie regret to zero.

nodes.label: Project Python3.14.7 and uv0.12.18 locked setup
nodes.rationale: uv.lock fixes runtime/dev versions and hashes; hatchling1.32.3 separately pins backend but isolated build dependencies are not fully hermetic.

nodes.label: Workspace Temp/cache and basetemp parent
nodes.rationale: Install in a new ignored environment, preserve .venv, and create basetemp parent before pytest; uv offline needs warmed prerequisites.

nodes.label: Default test-body Python network guard
nodes.source_location: Offline boundary and opt-in source checks
nodes.rationale: Blocks socket creation/connections/DNS during tests; collection-time imports, saved aliases, native calls and subprocesses are outside guarantee.

nodes.rationale: Marked tests skip by default, unmarked tests remain blocked even with flag; live datasets were not verified.

nodes.rationale: First sandbox DNS failure remained partial; clean-env-2 actually installed19 locked packages and passed compatibility/tests without replacing .venv.

nodes.label: Separate upstream Python3.11.7 Linux environment
nodes.rationale: Keep atschalz/dc_tabeval separate from project stack and record actual commit/versions/commands/errors.

nodes.rationale: D011-D020 dispositions and scope were recorded; acceptance of design did not implement future protections or complete P033-023.

nodes.label: P033-002 environment and CI completed
nodes.rationale: Recorded actual clean install,38 offline tests, shell checks, matrix repetition and separate CI fix; scientific settings unchanged.

nodes.rationale: P033-003 remains READY, P033-023 DECISION, real benchmarks/dataset downloads/upstream and full T14/G1 were not completed.
